title: Do not prescribe a binary upgrade for every malformed readiness field
outcome: Retained Low finding from authoritative Claude session-7089 adjudication. src/engram_readiness.rs maps all readiness deserialization failures to unsupported or invalid receipt plus update the binary. A schema-v1 receipt with null control or another malformed required field receives the same upgrade advice as an unsupported binary, hiding the actual field-shape failure. Separate unsupported schema/envelope diagnosis from malformed current-schema fields, retaining fail-closed behavior and no Full Audit fallback. Do not relax exact assurance or canonical identity checks.
acceptance: Tests distinguish unsupported/missing schema from malformed v1 control/required fields. Error messages identify the relevant problem and do not assert that a binary upgrade fixes a field-shape failure. Neither path falls back to doctor or saves settings.
